S_hunter_pricing.quote: Starter ... $49 /month billed monthly ($34 billed yearly, $408/yr) ... 2,000 credits per month (24,000 per year) ... Credit cost: Email found · 1 credit

S_hunter_api.quote: Email Finder: A verification is automatically performed on each email found. If no email can be found, no credit is charged.

S_apollo_pricing.quote: Basic $49 Per seat per month, billed annually; 30,000 credits per seat per year, granted upfront (no monthly-billing price is shown on the page)

S_apollo_credits.quote: You're only charged credits for email addresses that Apollo can verify. (Knowledge base: one credit per verified email for a net-new contact.)

S_prospeo_pricing.quote: Starter: Monthly Price $49, Yearly Price $441 ($37/mo); Monthly Credits 2000, Yearly Credits 24000. One credit gives you one verified business email.

S_prospeo_api.quote: Enriching a person record costs 1 credit per email found ... You won't be charged if no results are found.

S_dropcontact_pricing.quote: Starter 500 credits ... 79 EUR /monthly ... Pay on success ... Native and exclusive email validation (Monthly / Yearly -20%)

S_ecb_fx.quote: Euro foreign exchange reference rate 2026-11-19: USD 1.0992

S_amf.publisher: Anymail Finder (vendor; a participant in its own benchmark, disclosed)
S_amf.quote: 14 tools tested on the same 5,000 B2B contacts (US, UK, France, Germany), every returned email verified by BounceBan, ZeroBounce and MillionVerifier; no live send. Per-contact CSV (CC BY 4.0): https://anymailfinder.com/email-finder-benchmark/email-finder-benchmark-data.csv

S_orbi.publisher: OrbiSearch (vendor; a participant in its own benchmark)
S_orbi.quote: 7 email finders tested on the same 288 B2B contacts (NA 95 / EMEA 99 / APAC 94), every returned address re-verified live. Per-contact CSV (CC BY 4.0): https://orbisearch.com/research/email-finder-benchmark-2026.csv

S_dropcontact_bench.publisher: Dropcontact (vendor; funded and designed its own benchmark)
S_dropcontact_bench.quote: 15 tools, 20,000 contacts, live send counting hard bounces. Base = 17,132 contacts with >=1 email found by any tool. Dropcontact: 9,584 raw (55.9%), 9,402 usable (54.9%). Hunter: 6,665 raw (38.9%), 744 hard bounce (11.2%), 5,570 usable (32.5%). Apollo and Prospeo not tested. Used only to motivate the sensitivity sweep.
